prompt: 在2027年2月24日社區活動中心雨後課堂活動中，在「2-Ⅳ-9：角色扮演」能力練習中，Which sentence best summarizes this message: 'Please bring a reusable bottle on Friday.'？

options.text: Students should bring a reusable bottle on Friday.
Students should bring a new desk on Monday.
The bottle is not allowed on Friday.
The message is about a school holiday.

answer.explanation: The summary keeps the item and the day stated in the message. 本題對應 KG「2-Ⅳ-9：角色扮演」，情境為2027年2月24日社區活動中心雨後。
